## --- Day 1: Sample Puzzle ---

The _Elves_ need your help sorting `widgets` before the big launch.

Read the [about page](https://adventofcode.com/2024/about) or the [external docs](https://example.com/docs).

```
3   4
4   3
2   5
```

- Pair up the _smallest_ number on the left with the smallest on the right.
- The answer is `11`.

What is the _total distance_ between your lists?
